footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss to Global Net Lease: after $89.7M of discontinued operations, $43.7M attributable to noncontrolling interests.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue fell 13.1% to $495M in 2025. Operating income fell 41.0% to $111M, a 22.4% margin.
The net loss widened to $269M, or −$1.21 per share, from $175M. Operating cash flow was $223M and free cash flow $189M, versus $254M; Global Net Lease returned $312M through dividends and buybacks.
